gloss: former years; olden days; years past

definitions.gloss: former years; olden days; years past
definitions.explanation: A literary and formal term referring to times long gone by. Used to evoke a sense of nostalgia or historical distance, typically in written or formal spoken contexts.

examples.japanese: {昔年|せきねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面影|おもかげ}→面影：06631_omokage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
{昔年|せきねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恩|おん}→恩：02550_on⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I will never forget the kindness shown to me in years past.

examples.japanese: {昔年|せきねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{栄華|えいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{偲|しの}ばせる→偲ぶ：30130_shinobu⟧⟦{城跡|しろあと}→城跡：16199_shiroato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The castle ruins, evoking the splendor of bygone years, stood quietly atop the hill.

notes:
Composed of {昔|せき} (past, former — the on'yomi of ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧) and ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year). A literary and formal word that is used almost exclusively in written language, speeches, and formal essays. In everyday conversation, ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧ or ⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧ would be used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昔年|せきねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友|とも}→友：03466_tomo⟧: a friend from years past
- {昔年|せきねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧: memories of former years
- {昔年|せきねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしむ→懐かしむ：09913_natsukashimu⟧: to look back fondly on past years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧: long ago — the everyday word for the past
- {往年|おうねん}: past years — also literary but more commonly seen, especially in {往年|おうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (of former days)
- {旧年|きゅうねん}: last year; the old year — specifically the previous year, often used at New Year
